Ana (Eng): Quick sync — Polaris trial cutover next Wed. Need confirmation on who owns: TLS certs, staging keys, webhook mapping.
Sam (SE): I can take webhook mapping + sample payloads. Can someone drop schema?
Leila (PM): @Sam thanks. Jordan to own customer onboarding and acceptance criteria?
Jordan (Sales): Yep, I'll handle onboarding doc and acceptance checklist. Need staging creds from their infra.
Mike (SRE): For certs/ingress: Are we using their LB IP allowlist or VPN? If allowlist, send IPs. If VPN, need contact.
Sam (SE): They said IP allowlist. Jordan — can you get contact + port list? Also we need CORS for the testing UI.
Jordan (Sales): Reached out, ticket #INC-5421. Asked for allowlist and test user. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Ana (Eng): Code review ping: PR #4823 ready for review — adds retries + idempotency for webhook handler. @Mike could you glance at connection handling?
Mike (SRE): Will review today. Quick note: ensure `X-Client-Version` header is allowed by proxy.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: staging on 2026-03-18 02:00 UTC — automated smoke tests will run.
Leila (PM): Success criteria for go/no-go: (1) 95% of sample prompts return under 300ms, (2) no auth errors in 1000-run smoke, (3) end-to-end sample flow validated by SE.
Sam (SE): I'll run the smoke with their test creds once Jordan confirms.
Ana (Eng): If Jordan gets creds today, we can do a dry run tomorrow morning. Otherwise slide to Friday.
Jordan (Sales): Got creds from their infra — emailing them now. Will post in thread when live. :thumbsup: 
Leila (PM): Thanks all — can we update the JIRA epic with owners? I'll add Ana/Sam/Mike/Jordan now.
Sam (SE): Minor ask: can the sample payload include a 4k token case? we need latency profile.
Ana (Eng): Yep, include one long prompt and one short. Thanks.
